description:
Spotify to Teams Status Sync

Automatically syncs your currently playing Spotify track to your Microsoft Teams status message. Set a custom status message using placeholders like {artist}, {track}, {album}, and {emoji}.
What's Changed
- docs: truth pass — real log paths, status rules, stale counts and anchors by @Carme99 in #639
- fix(windows): detached panes can close, log viewer stickiness, update banner, a11y by @Carme99 in #638
- fix(spotify): reuse the HTTP client, drop the 304 allocation, tighten the profanity filter by @Carme99 in #641
- fix(ui): dashboard presence hydration, settings edit guarding, detached guards, a11y by @Carme99 in #643
- fix(diagnostics): redaction gaps, honest save-to-file, render the collected fields by @Carme99 in #640
- fix(shell): window lifecycle, refresh-aware tray playback, updater staging UX by @Carme99 in #644
- ci: tag/version consistency gate, release verification job, EOL Node, packaging fixes by @Carme99 in #646
- fix(tray): stop the dashboard sending a stale tray-state claim (#592) by @Carme99 in #647
- fix(polling): auth-only failure exit, mid-track rule evaluation, cadence correctness by @Carme99 in #648
- fix(auth): reconnect must re-authorize, not destroy credentials by @Carme99 in #645
- fix(auth): token store and keychain hardening by @Carme99 in #649
- feat(updater): live stage progress and cancel for install-on-quit (#590) by @Carme99 in #650
- fix(config): config integrity — merge instead of replace, schema authority, quarantine surfacing by @Carme99 in #651
- chore(deps): bump vitest to 4.1.11 for GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 (#642) by @Carme99 in #652
- feat(logs): backfill the log viewer from the on-disk log tail (#595) by @Carme99 in #653
- fix(deeplink): re-claim the presencejam:// scheme on macOS at every launch (#628) by @Carme99 in #654
- refactor(fe): one listener disposer, CLDR plural/number formatting, real auth-flow tests by @Carme99 in #655
- feat(spotify): richer status placeholders, podcast episodes and tray mode toggles by @Carme99 in #656
- fix(auth): surface a locked system keychain instead of "not configured" (#560) by @Carme99 in #657
- feat(diagnostics): warn when a corrupt config was quarantined and settings reset (#537) by @Carme99 in #658
- feat(presence): rule-driven availability, manual-status respect, bounded sessions, out-of-office gating by @Carme99 in #659
- fix(profanity,polling): consume the extra-word lexicon and the pause-backoff ceiling (#538) by @Carme99 in #661
- docs: 4.6 feature and behaviour pass by @Carme99 in #660
- chore(release): 4.6.0 by @Carme99 in #662
